I don't follow all the technical choices, and I don't need to — that's your area. What matters to me is that the plan still delivers what we agreed: saving and opening links, tags, search and filtering, editing, deleting with a confirmation, keeping my bookmarks private to me, and getting around by keyboard. It sounds like all of that is covered, and I'm glad the automatic title lookup is written down as the next thing to add.

This works for me. Please go ahead and create the implementation tasks.
